thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High 5xx/error spike observed for tenant AsterHealth during canary rollout to dedicated-vpc-nyc pool. Canary error rate ~18% over 5m window, affecting canary subset (~7% of their traffic). Affected canary nodes: node-nyc-c-3, node-nyc-c-4. Suggested action: halt canary + pinback to previous artifact.

Jay (oncall): I'm on it. Halting canary traffic now. @Marta can you confirm rollback artifact and whether we should isolate the tenant?

Marta (runtime): Confirmed previous stable artifact: model-rev-2026-02-pinned. Recommend pinback to that artifact and disable prefix KV caching for AsterHealth while we investigate. I'll start the rollback once deploy team gives ack.

Ibrahim (eng-release): Noted. Seeing KV-cache eviction traces in the canary logs that coincide with the 5xxs — likely a runtime path for quantized kernels. Disabling prefix cache for the tenant is a low-risk mitigation.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic drain initiated for nodes [node-nyc-c-3, node-nyc-c-4]. 2/2 instances entering DRAIN state.

Jay (oncall): Run pinback command and start rollout rewind. Post the exact commands so infra can follow.

Marta (runtime): Executing. Commands:
```
# pin back to previous artifact
rwctl deploy rollback --customer=asterhealth --pool=dedicated-vpc-nyc --to-artifact=model-rev-2026-02-pinned --reason="canary 5xx spike"

# isolate tenant (quarantine to avoid cross-tenant impact)
rwctl tenant isolate --tenant=asterhealth --pool=dedicated-vpc-nyc
```

Sam (infra): Acknowledged. I'll watch network and routing while the rollback runs. If rollback exceeds 20m we'll failover their canary traffic to us-east fallback pool.

Ibrahim (eng-release): Also applying runtime config to disable prefix KV caching for AsterHealth:
```
rwctl config set --tenant=asterhealth runtime.cache.prefix=false --persist
```
This should avoid the eviction-induced header mismatch.

Priya (cs): I'll draft a customer-facing update now: "We're reverting the recent canary deployment and applying a temporary runtime config to prevent further errors. Expected completion 10-20 minutes. No data loss. We'll follow up with RCA." Will ping once sent.

Lena (solutions): FYI the customer is in EU but using dedicated-vpc-nyc for throughput—they reported timeouts from a subset of backend calls. Please include latency numbers in update.

Marta (runtime): Rollback step 1/3: triggering artifact pinback. Status: started.

deploy-bot: Rollback command accepted; scheduler task id: task-8812. Draining complete on node-nyc-c-3, node-nyc-c-4. New jobs launching with model-rev-2026-02-pinned on nodes [node-nyc-c-7, node-nyc-c-8].

Jay (oncall): Good. While rollout rewinds, increase pool desired by +2 to reduce warmup tail latency (temp).

Marta (runtime): Scaling +2. Command used: `rwctl pool scale --pool=dedicated-vpc-nyc --delta=2`

Sam (infra): Noted scaling. Monitoring for pod crash loops and OOM. No new OOMs so far.

Ibrahim (eng-release): After we stabilize, we'll collect full canary logs and a small repro harness. Early hypothesis: quantized attention kernels + prefix cache eviction race.

Priya (cs): Update sent to customer at 11:07 UTC: "We're reverting the canary and applying a mitigation. Expecting <20m to clear. We'll follow up with a technical summary after stabilization." Customer replied: "Thanks, please keep us posted. Impact is visible on a small percent of our requests."

Marta (runtime): Rollback 2/3: majority traffic moved to pinned artifact. Health checks passing on nodes [node-nyc-c-7, node-nyc-c-8]. Error rate dropping to ~2.1% in the last 2m.

deploy-bot: task-8812 status: SUCCEEDED. Artifact pinned back to model-rev-2026-02-pinned for AsterHealth on dedicated-vpc-nyc.

Jay (oncall): Good work. Leave tenant isolated for now until we confirm stability for 30m. Priya keep the customer updated that we're monitoring.

Priya (cs): Customer notified at 11:25 UTC, they reported reduced errors on their side. They asked for ETA for full rollback and RCA. Told them we'll provide RCA within 48 hours.

Marta (runtime): Applying final mitigation flags for AsterHealth: prefix cache disabled and KV eviction guard increased. Commands recorded in incident doc.

Ibrahim (eng-release): Scheduling a postmortem and a small test matrix to reproduce the cache eviction path with quantized kernels. Will include perf counters and KV traces.

Sam (infra): All checks normal. No collateral impact to other tenants. Leaving a watch on scaling and network for 30m.

Jay (oncall): Handoff to next oncall (Marta) in 30m — I'll annotate the incident with timeline and actions. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved? Monitoring status changed to WATCHING. Creator: Jay (oncall). Final summary: canary rollback to pinned artifact completed; temporary runtime config applied (prefix cache disabled) and tenant isolated during verification window. Customer Impact: canary subset (~7% of traffic) experienced elevated 5xxs; mitigated within ~18 minutes.

Lena (solutions): Please add follow-up items: (1) reproduce with quantized kernel flags, (2) add a pre-rollout cache-safety check in the rollout pipeline, (3) document remediation runbook for dedicated-vpc canaries.

Priya (cs): Customer happy with the quick rollback. They'll await RCA. Closing communications loop.

Jay (oncall): Closing thread, will link to incident postmortem doc when created.

Marta (runtime): :white_check_mark: will own the RCA and follow-ups.

deploy-bot: Incident thread archived by deploy-bot at 11:58 UTC.
